answer: A recursive Halo2 proof-of-personhood circuit lets each agent register once by proving knowledge of a secret inside a committed cipher, binding identity to a nullifier that blocks duplicate enrollment. To prevent sockpuppet farming, the protocol grows a garden of stake-weighted trust edges where new identities must spiral outward from vouched seeds, and any collusive. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
